ask: Users want one live view of sessions, agents, tasks, and their state.
plugin: A monitor reads local session records and hook events, then serves a searchable roster with status, project, and activity.

ask: Users want to find, tag, sort, and group sessions by project or priority.
plugin: A monitor indexes local session metadata and transcripts and offers search, tags, pins, and project grouping; function UI hooks can surface the same controls in local views.

ask: Users want stable, meaningful session names and identifiers across views and messages.
plugin: A function hook maintains a session title registry and rewrites supported UI labels and message metadata; a command lets the user rename a session.

ask: Users want quicker, predictable session creation and switching in local views.
plugin: Function UI hooks add shortcuts, current-project defaults, and recent-session navigation in the local session picker.

ask: Users want to fork or branch conversations and keep the resulting session findable.
plugin: A command creates a branch with local transcript metadata; function hooks register its relationship in local session views.

ask: Users want durable export, backup, and restoration of session history.
plugin: A bin executable and session-end hook export local JSONL transcripts with metadata and restore searchable copies.

ask: Users want a readable record and recap of long or background conversations.
plugin: A command parses session JSONL and subagent transcripts into a searchable reader and produces a recap on demand.

ask: Users want to know whether long-running agents are working, blocked, or wedged.
plugin: A monitor combines hook heartbeats with process and transcript activity and emits a progress signal or stall alert.

ask: Users want the resolved model, effort, and configuration of each agent to be visible.
plugin: An agent-spawn function hook records the resolved settings and adds them to agent status, summaries, and local UI.

ask: Users want live token, cost, and context figures for sessions and agent trees.
plugin: A function hook reads session usage and accumulates agent subtree totals, then renders a statusline or local UI panel.

ask: Users want to dismiss or reap completed background jobs without losing live work.
plugin: A command and monitor reconcile process, transcript, and agent state before archiving completed roster entries.

ask: Users want durable messages and stable addresses between Claude Code sessions and agents.
plugin: An MCP mailbox stores session-addressed messages and wakes or delivers to recipients; session send and receive hooks keep identity metadata.

ask: Users want a visual map of parent, child, and workflow relationships.
plugin: A monitor builds a DAG from session and agent metadata and displays running steps with their dependencies.

ask: Users want to choose agent model, effort, isolation, and launch options before dispatch.
plugin: A command and agent-spawn function hook collect launch options and enforce resolved model and isolation choices.

ask: Users want predictable worktree names, isolation, and cleanup.
plugin: Git lifecycle settings hooks apply naming rules, create isolated worktrees, and verify safety before cleanup.

ask: Users want sessions to follow moved folders and remember project paths.
plugin: A monitor and command map stable project identities to current paths and relink local session metadata after a move.

ask: Users want agents to obey repository rules before commits, pushes, merges, and destructive git actions.
plugin: PreToolUse and function tool-call hooks inspect git commands against a project policy and block unapproved actions.

ask: Users want repeatable PR checks, CI repair, and branch updates.
plugin: A GitHub MCP server and commands inspect PR checks and comments, apply fixes, and open or update PRs under an approval hook.

ask: Users want deterministic browser, profile, device, and tab selection.
plugin: An MCP browser server binds projects to explicit browser profiles and stable tab IDs and shows the active binding.

ask: Users want better viewport, upload, screenshot, and low-level input controls.
plugin: A browser MCP server exposes CDP viewport emulation, file upload, screenshot-to-disk, and key or pointer primitives.

ask: Users want automation of local, private, or authenticated sites that the built-in browser blocks.
plugin: A local browser MCP server runs a user-owned profile with explicit origin allowlists and browser authentication support.

ask: Users want reliable reading of dynamic pages and artifact links.
plugin: A Playwright or CDP MCP server waits for page readiness and extracts DOM, text, and authenticated artifact content.

ask: Users want connector tools with usable schemas, payloads, and missing options.
plugin: A proxy MCP server normalizes tool schemas and results and adds connector-specific options before exposing them to Claude.

ask: Users want skills and plugin configuration available across execution locations.
plugin: A versioned MCP registry and setup skill export instructions into cloud sessions where repository setup scripts or plugins can run.

ask: Users want attention, completion, and error notifications that distinguish states without noise.
plugin: Lifecycle settings hooks and a monitor classify session events, suppress duplicates, and send configurable desktop or terminal alerts.

ask: Users want pending permissions and questions from many sessions in one place.
plugin: PermissionRequest hooks write pending decisions to a local monitor inbox and link each request to its session.

ask: Users want configurable keyboard shortcuts for local Claude Code views.
plugin: Function UI press hooks bind user-configured shortcuts for session, agent, pane, and composer actions.

ask: Users want control over Enter, newline, queued prompts, and replies.
plugin: Function UI input and prompt hooks implement configurable submit keys, durable drafts, and an optional turn queue.

ask: Users want readable tool, thinking, and agent messages in the transcript.
plugin: Function UI render hooks collapse or expand chosen message types, preserve scroll position, and expose a compact reading view.

ask: Users want readable colors, fonts, widths, image previews, and pane layouts in local Code views.
plugin: Function UI render hooks apply user-configured themes and layout rules on the local desktop or terminal surface.

ask: Users want predictable handling of file paths, attachments, and editor targets.
plugin: Function UI hooks and a command retain source filenames, resolve moved paths, and open files in a configured editor.

ask: Users want hands-free speech input and spoken answers during Code sessions.
plugin: An audio-enabled MCP server or bin executable transcribes microphone audio and speaks session answers, with a command to toggle the loop.

ask: Users want autonomous loops bounded by time and spend.
plugin: A function hook measures usage per turn and pauses recurring tasks at a configured limit.

ask: Users want reproducible cloud session setup from their repository.
plugin: A setup skill and bin script install project dependencies and load checked-in configuration when the cloud environment runs the plugin.

ask: Users want to observe and reconnect to remote-controlled local sessions reliably.
plugin: A monitor tracks local remote-control registrations and process state and offers explicit reconnect commands.

ask: Users want scheduled tasks with explicit model, effort, execution mode, and visibility.
plugin: An MCP scheduling facade records model and effort choices, validates permissions, and lists pending and completed runs.

ask: Users want to control suggested replies and next-action prompts.
plugin: Function prompt-suggest and UI hooks filter, rank, or disable suggestions according to user preferences.

ask: Users want to know which instructions and settings a live session actually received.
plugin: A function prompt-context hook records injected instructions and a command shows their provenance and active values.

ask: Users want predictable tool permissions and a check before dangerous or unauthorized actions.
plugin: PreToolUse settings hooks and function tool checks enforce a policy over shell, file, browser, and MCP actions.

ask: Users want frequently used slash commands easy to reach.
plugin: A function UI hook adds favorites to the local command picker and stores choices in plugin state.

ask: Users want browser-exposed tools discovered and available to Claude.
plugin: An MCP bridge discovers WebMCP endpoints in the active page and presents approved page tools to Claude.

ask: Users want Claude to add items and update fields in GitHub Projects v2.
plugin: A GitHub MCP server exposes Projects v2 item and field operations with scoped authentication.

ask: Users want personal context across projects and sessions.
plugin: An MCP memory server stores user-scoped notes and a skill retrieves them on demand.

ask: Users want MCP calls correlated with their originating session and prompt.
plugin: A function tool-call hook attaches trace metadata and an MCP proxy forwards it downstream.

ask: Users want persistent defaults for diff mode and collapsed files.
plugin: Function UI hooks persist diff display preferences in local Code views.

ask: Users want visible compaction progress in local Code sessions.
plugin: A function UI hook reports compaction state while the session.compact hook runs.

ask: Users want the Code terminal and Run action to use their chosen shell.
plugin: A function process-spawn hook selects the configured local shell.

ask: Users want completion marking and delayed archiving of local sessions.
plugin: A command marks local sessions complete, while a monitor delays archive until the configured PR lifecycle event.

ask: Users want faster file selection and deep path mentions in local Code views.
plugin: Function UI hooks index project paths and present deep files and remembered folders.

ask: Users want to open the side chat without typing a prompt.
plugin: A command and function UI hook open the local side chat from an empty /btw invocation.

ask: Users want opt-in access to their own saved credentials during approved browser tasks.
plugin: An MCP vault adapter requests approval per site and action, then fills credentials without exposing them in model context.

ask: Users want encrypted recovery of local Desktop configuration and extension settings.
plugin: A bin executable exports selected local settings into an encrypted user-owned backup and restores them after inspection.

ask: Users want I/O-heavy agent workflows to use more than a CPU-derived concurrency cap.
plugin: A workflow command dispatches bounded parallel agents with a configurable concurrency limit and reports their results.

ask: Users want the local model picker to follow their chosen order.
plugin: A function UI hook orders model options using plugin userConfig.

ask: Users want subprocesses to know which Code session owns them.
plugin: A function process-spawn hook injects the current session ID into local terminal environments.

ask: Users want read and unread state synced across their own devices.
plugin: Function UI hooks record local read events in an MCP-backed store and restore them on another device.

ask: Users want Claude Code local UI text available in their language.
plugin: Function UI render hooks replace labels using a user-selected localization catalog.

ask: Users want the terminal to open automatically for new local Code sessions.
plugin: A function UI hook opens the local terminal panel when a new session starts.

ask: Users want persistent background session management.
plugin: A monitor and bin daemon supervise user-owned session processes and report their state through a command.
